s21.headline: Where should we raise the engineering bar first?

evidence: Behaviour they have verified — including the token that should fail
s22.line: AI can write the code. Engineers still own the outcome.
actions: Students and educators — Change one learning task · add explanation, debugging or a changed requirement
Graduates and developers — Choose one capability to demonstrate · produce evidence beyond a working demo
Engineering leaders — Update one development plan · specify practice, feedback and proof of progress
s22.prompt: Write down one change you'll make in the next seven days.

s23.l1: AI is changing how we build software.
